items.title: Palo Alto Networks (PANW) Unveils Unit 42 AI Defense For Always On Cybersecurity
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks (NasdaqGS:PANW) has launched Unit 42 Continuous Frontier AI Defense, a new always-on cybersecurity service for enterprises. The service leverages advanced models from OpenAI and Anthropic to provide continuous vulnerability detection and automated remediation support. Unit 42 Continuous Frontier AI Defense is designed to address growing concerns about AI driven cyber threats targeting global organizations.
